description: This file declares the BackendImpl class, which implements the Backend interface for a disk cache system. It includes methods for cache initialization, entry management, eviction, statistics, and testing, and references various internal and external components related to disk caching.

classes.name: BackendImpl
classes.description: Implements the Backend interface for disk cache management, handling cache entries, storage, eviction, and statistics.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Performs general asynchronous initialization of the cache instance.

methods.name: SyncInit
methods.description: Performs actual initialization and cleanup synchronously.

methods.name: SyncOpenEntry
methods.description: Opens a cache entry synchronously by key.

methods.name: SyncCreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a cache entry synchronously.

methods.name: SyncDoomEntry
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key synchronously.

methods.name: SyncDoomAllEntries
methods.description: Deletes all cache entries synchronously.

methods.name: SyncDoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Deletes entries within a time range synchronously.

methods.name: SyncCalculateSizeOfAllEntries
methods.description: Calculates total size of all entries synchronously.

methods.name: SyncDoomEntriesSince
methods.description: Deletes entries since a given time synchronously.

methods.name: SyncOpenNextEntry
methods.description: Opens the next entry in enumeration synchronously.

methods.name: SyncEndEnumeration
methods.description: Ends enumeration of entries.

methods.name: SyncOnExternalCacheHit
methods.description: Handles external cache hit event.

methods.name: GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of cache entries.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Asynchronously opens or creates a cache entry.

methods.name: OpenEntry
methods.description: Asynchronously opens a cache entry.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a cache entry.

methods.name: DoomEntry
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a cache entry.

methods.name: DoomAllEntries
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes all cache entries.

methods.name: DoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes entries within a time range.

methods.name: DoomEntriesSince
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes entries since a time.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfAllEntries
methods.description: Asynchronously calculates total size of entries.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for cache entries.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves cache statistics.

methods.name: OnExternalCacheHit
methods.description: Handles external cache hit event.
